worldcombat.skill.matblock.summary: Tears a whole tatami mat up as a shield, eating move damage for the user and nearby allies. The mat falls once it is used up, and status moves pass under it.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.use.0: Eat a whole spread of damaging moves for the team
worldcombat.skill.matblock.use.1: Raise the mat a beat before a heavy hit lands
worldcombat.skill.matblock.use.2: Keep one burst outside the mat
worldcombat.skill.matblock.description.0: The mat absorbs about %1$s points of enemy move damage for the caster and each protected ally, standing for about %2$s s; it falls once used up. Status moves, environmental damage and status wear pass through it.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.description.1: On cast it covers the user and allies within %1$s blocks; a protected ally who strays too far from the caster, or loses line of sight, is dropped early.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.fold.upright: Upright: absorption x1.3, duration x1.15, radius x0.85, at +2 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — thick and hard to batter through.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.fold.spread: Spread: radius x1.25, absorption x0.8, duration x0.85, in exchange for -1 tick wind-up and x0.85 cooldown — wide and quick to raise.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.timing: The user holds position while raising the mat; after %1$s s of preparation it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.preference.fo: Upright: absorption x1.3, duration x1.15, radius x0.85, +2 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — thick and hard to batter through, good for stonewalling one heavy blow. Spread: radius x1.25, absorption x0.8, duration x0.85, -1 tick wind-up, x0.85 cooldown — wide and quick, good for covering scattered allies.
worldcombat.skill.matblock.preference.ai: Consider raising the mat when a threat is within this distance; larger predicts earlier but wastes more mats.
When on, the mat is only raised while another ally is inside the alert radius; when off, pressure on the user is enough.
